generate_pose3d_target: generate 3D pose targets from 2D keypoints and depth using camera intrinsic matrix K
pack_pose3d_inputs: pack 3D pose inputs including pose3d and pose3d_visible fields into data samples for model input
apply_random_bbox_transform: apply random shift and scale transformations to bounding box centers and scales for data augmentation
apply_random_flip_augmentation: apply random horizontal vertical or diagonal flip augmentation to images keypoints and camera matrix K
apply_affine_transform: apply top-down affine warp to crop and resize images around bounding boxes with camera matrix adjustment
